11: Story `P2-P` (`p2-p-frontend-shell-dashboard-and-notifications` — Portal Shell, GCash Design Tokens, Dashboard Widgets & Notification Bell UI) delivers the foundational React 19 + TypeScript 5.9 + Vite 7 single-page application shell in `app/frontend/` on top of the verified BFF authentication endpoints (`P2-A` / `ADR 0007`), IAM RBAC/SoD/`View-As` controls (`P2-B` / `ADR 0008`, `P2-N` / `ADR 0019`), and Audit/Notification/Dashboard APIs (`P2-I` / `ADR 0015`, `P2-O` / `ADR 0020`). Governing requirements from `docs/agents-v0/requirements/p2-p-frontend-shell-dashboard-and-notifications.md`, `docs/agents-v0/architecture.md`, `docs/agents-v0/design/system/nfr-slo.md`, `frontend-web.mdc`, `ux-design.mdc`, `security-baseline.mdc`, and `vapt-webapp.mdc` establish five non-trivial architectural and security constraints:
12: 
13: 1. **Memory-Only Session State, `HttpOnly` Cookie Authentication, and Cross-Account Logout Isolation (`AC-1`, `AC-5`, `security-baseline.mdc` §3, §4, §8, `vapt-webapp.mdc` F1, F2, F7):**
14:    - On mount, the portal shell must bootstrap the authenticated operator profile via `GET /api/v1/auth/me` with `credentials: "include"` and `X-Correlation-ID` (`PrincipalSessionResponse`: `userId`, `workspaceEmail`, `displayName`, `department`, `roles`, `permissions`, `effectiveViewAsRole`, `readOnlyOverlay`, `redirectView`).
15:    -

idated session claims, roles, permissions, dashboard counts, and notification state must reside strictly in React memory state (`src/store/slices/`), never writing access tokens, refresh tokens, session identifiers, or static RBAC matrices to `localStorage`, `sessionStorage`, or `document.cookie` (`AC-1`).
16:    - When `User A` signs out (`POST /api/v1/auth/logout` returning `HTTP 204 No Content`) or receives `HTTP 401 Unauthorized`, the client must atomically reset all in-memory slices (session, dashboard widgets, notification drawer, problem detail modal), call `localStorage.clear()` and `sessionStorage.clear()`, and return to the sign-in screen so a subsequent login by `User B` on the same browser renders exclusively `User B`'s session, navigation, widgets, and notifications (`AC-5`, `vapt-webapp.mdc` F1).
17:    - Production Vite builds (`app/frontend/vite.config.ts`) must explicitly set `build.sourcemap: false` (`vapt-webapp.mdc` F2).
18: 
19: 2. **Dynamic Server-Driven Navigation Filtering, Zero-Role Onboarding Redirect, and Client Route Authorization Guards (`AC-1`, `AC-7`, `vapt-webapp.mdc` F2, F4):**
20:    - Navigation menu items in `<nav aria-label="Primary workspace navigation">` must be filtered dynamically from the server-returned `PrincipalSessionResponse.permissions` array (matching both colon-delimited and uppercase underscore permission codes supported by the backend: `Dashboard` -> `audit:dashboard:read` / `AUDIT_DASHBOARD_READ`, `Report Execution` -> `execution:runs:read` / `EXECUTION_RUNS_READ`, `Configuration & Reference Data` -> `config:definitions:read` / `CONFIG_DEFINITIONS_READ` / `config:reference-tables:read` / `CONFIG_REFERENCE_TABLES_READ` / `config:schedules:read` / `CONFIG_SCHEDULES_READ`, `Governance Ticketing` -> `governance:tickets:read` / `GOVERNANCE_TICKETS_READ`, `IAM & Access` -> `iam:users:read` / `IAM_USERS_READ` / `iam:roles:read` / `IAM_ROLES_READ` / `iam:permissions:read` / `IAM_PERMISSIONS_READ`, `Audit Log Explorer` -> `audit:logs:read` / `AUDIT_LOGS_READ`) (`AC-1`).

60: - **Option 2: Persisting `PrincipalSessionResponse` Roles, Permissions, and Unread Notification Cache in `localStorage` or `sessionStorage` Across Page Reloads**
61:   - *Pros:* Avoids a brief skeleton state during full browser page reload.
62:   - *Cons:* Directly violates `AC-1`, `AC-5`, `security-baseline.mdc` §4, `vapt-webapp.mdc` F1/F2, and Philippines Data Privacy Act (RA 10173) by writing workforce identity claims and RBAC permissions to browser web storage where XSS or shared workstation sessions could read stale entitlements.
63: 
64: - **Option 3: Hardcoding a Client-Side Role-to-Route RBAC Matrix in TypeScript Constants and Hiding Navigation Links Without Client Route Boundary Guards**
65:   - *Pros:* Slightly simpler navigation component props.
66:   - *Cons:* Directly violates `AC-1`, `AC-7`, `security-baseline.mdc` §2, §3, and `vapt-webapp.mdc` F2/F4: client bundles must not embed static RBAC role matrices, and direct URL navigation (`/runs`, `/configuration`, `/tickets`, `/iam`, `/audit-logs`) must enforce route permission checks rather than relying on hidden `<nav>` links alone.
67: 
68: - **Option 4: Rendering Server-Returned Notification `subject` / `messageBody` and RFC 7807 `detail` via `dangerouslySetInnerHTML` and Ephemeral Toast Popups Without Correlation IDs**
69:   - *Pros:* Allows HTML formatting in alert bodies.
70:   - *Cons:* Introduces DOM XSS vulnerabilities (`frontend-web.mdc`, `AC-3`, `AC-6`) and fails BSP Circular 982/1019 operational auditability by omitting copyable `correlationId` and `errorCode` fields from an accessible `role="alertdialog"` modal.
71: 
72: ## Consequences
73: 
74: - **Positive:**
75:   - Every `/api/v1/**` call from the SPA carries a UUID v4 `X-Correlation-ID` and `credentials: "include"`, and every 4xx/5xx `application/problem+json` response opens a focus-trapped RFC 7807 `alertdialog` modal with one-click `correlationId` copy (`AC-1`, `AC-6`).
76:   - `User
<truncated 49 bytes>
ed in memory and storage (`AC-5`, `vapt-webapp.mdc` F1), direct URL navigation is guarded against unauthorized roles (`AC-7`, `vapt-webapp.mdc` F4), and cross-user notification BOLA `403`/`404` responses never leak another user's notification data (`AC-6`, `vapt-webapp.mdc` F8).
77:   - The Dashboard and Notification Bell drawer provide accessible loading, empty, error, and populated states styled with GCash design tokens (`AC-2`, `AC-3`, `AC-4`).
78: - **Negative:**
79:   - Full browser reload executes `GET /api/v1/auth/me` before rendering protected routes (`p95 <= 150 ms`).
80: - **Neutral:**
81:   - Downstream stories `P2-Q`, `P2-R`, `P2-S`, and `P2-T` plug their feature workspace components directly into the shell routes (`/runs`, `/configuration`, `/tickets`, `/iam`, `/audit-logs`) and reuse the shared API client, store provider, and RFC 7807 Problem Detail modal.
82: 
83: ## Compliance
84: 
85: - `architecture-and-diagrams.mdc`: Preserves the C4 `webApp -> bffApi` container boundary (`docs/agents-v0/architecture.md`); all state mutations and queries traverse versioned `/api/v1/**` endpoints.
86: - `api-and-events.mdc`: Consumes the approved OpenAPI 3.0.3 contract (`docs/agents-v0/design/p2-p-frontend-shell-dashboard-and-notifications/openapi.yaml`); sends `Idempotency-Key` on notification read `POST` mutations; parses the single RFC 7807 `application/problem+json` error envelope.
87: - `security-baseline.mdc` & `vapt-webapp.mdc`: Enforces memory-only session state with `HttpOnly` cookie auth (`F1`, `F7`), `build.sourcemap: false` and zero hardcoded RBAC matrices (`F2`), route-level permission guards and `View-As` read-only mutation blocking (`F4`), BOLA `403`/`404` isolation on `/api/v1/notifications/{id}` (`F8`), and XSS-safe plain-text rendering.
88: - `project-delivery-core.mdc` & `frontend-web.mdc`: Uses React 19, TypeScript 5.9, Vite 7, and Vitest under `app/frontend/src/{pages,features,components,services/api,store/slices}` with zero new backend services, message brokers, or client persistent caches.
